messages:
Maya K: heads up — int8 bring-up for veridian-lite on staging showing weird line-folding / mid-character breaks in CJK translation evals :eyes:
Jun Park: can you paste an example + exact quant/kernel config? :mag:
Maya K: model=veridian-lite:v2.1-rc3, quant=int8-sym, kernel=auto, runtime=verbatim-serving-staging. Running multilingual-translate harness with 'longform_ja_zh' test split
Alex Li: I ran the same harness earlier. BLEU drop ~2.8 on longform ja->zh. Short-sentence tests are fine. Repro steps below:
Alex Li: ```
./run_eval --model veridian-lite:v2.1-rc3 \n  --quant int8-sym \n  --dataset longform_ja_zh \n  --cache-prefix true \n  --batch 16
```
Maya K: example (input / expected / produced):
Maya K: ```
INPUT: これは長い文章の例で、複数の句や接続詞が混在しています。翻訳が行の折り返しで文字を分断してしまう。
EXPECTED: 这是一个较长的句子示例，包含多个子句和连接词。翻译不应在字符中间折行。
PRODUCED: 这是一个较长的句子示例，包含多个子句和连接词。翻译不应在字[ZWJ]中间折行。```
Jun Park: interesting — disabling prefix/KV cache locally removes the break for that sample. Could be a tokenization boundary shift introduced by the int8 kernel path + batching. Also check continuous-batching chunking.
Alex Li: metrics snapshot:
Alex Li: - master int8 baseline (kernel v1.4): BLEU=34.2
Alex Li: - veridian-lite:v2.1-rc3 int8 (kernel auto -> picks v2.0): BLEU=31.4
Alex Li: - veridian-lite int16 (non-quant) BLEU=34.1
Alex Li: so this looks like an int8 kernel regression, not dataset drift.
Maya K: sample id lf-ja-01234 reproduces sure. full input/text attached in eval output (linked in thread).
Jun Park: I'll kick off a bisect across q-kernel commits between 9f1a3c and bd42e7 to see which kernel change shifted token boundaries. Also will run the tokenizer pre/post normalization diff on that sample.
Alex Li: quick hack: route policy to fall back to veridian-legacy-int8 for requests with longform_ja_zh route until we patch. But we need safer compatibility checks — current kernel compatibility flags are too permissive.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: veridian-lite:v2.1-rc3 (quant=int8-sym) deployed to staging at 2026-03-18T10:23:00Z :rocket:
Maya K: can we add an eval gate that runs a small multilingual longform suite (ja/zh/ko) comparing detok token boundaries before promoting int8 kernels to prod?
Jun Park: yes — I'll add a pre-rollout smoke that toggles prefix-cache on/off and compares BLEU + character-boundary diffs. If boundary changes detected, fail the gate.
Alex Li: I'll open PR for (a) kernel compatibility stricter checks, (b) eval-gate job, (c) temporary route fallback rule. Assigning to @Jun and @Alex for implementation; @Maya to own triage & samples.
Maya K: thanks — I'll keep the failing sample set in the eval artifact and add a tiny harness to surface ZWJ/zerowidth anomalies.
Jun Park: started bisect job — will post commit when identified. :clock1:
Alex Li: TL;DR: int8 bring-up introduced a token-boundary regression under prefix cache + batching for long CJK lines. Action: bisect kernels, tighten compat checks, add longform eval gate, route fallback.
Maya K: 👍 will follow up with failing examples and artifacts.
